Name: Custom Names
Author: MindMeltMax
Description:
Give some personal flair to your tools, weapons, and even your trinkets.

You can change the name in the forge or in the mini-forge, the price of changing the name is configurable and defaults to 5 cinder shards.

The name of companions will display above their head when they're hovered over (configurable), and the name of any named item will show when it is selected in the toolbar (also configurable)

[size=5]How to install : [/size]
1. Install [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Smapi[/url]﻿
2. Unzip the file and place it in the mod folder
